pairs.before: You should make sure that the valve has been closed before the maintenance is being carried out.
pairs.after: Close the valve. Make sure that the valve is closed before you start the maintenance.
pairs.why: Imperative, no continuous form, no should, one action per sentence.

pairs.before: Once the panel has been removed, it's necessary to inspect the wiring, etc.
pairs.after: Remove the panel. Examine the wiring for damage.
pairs.why: No contraction, no etc., verbs instead of nouns.

pairs.before: If possible, the system could be restarted; this may fix the problem.
pairs.after: If the system does not respond, restart the system. The restart can correct the fault.
pairs.why: Condition first, no semicolon, can instead of may.

pairs.before: The pump is utilized for the purpose of providing pressure to the hydraulic system.
pairs.after: The pump supplies pressure to the hydraulic system.

pairs.before: The unit is designed to be operated by the crew at temperatures between -20 and 50 degrees.
pairs.after: The unit operates at temperatures from -20 to 50 degrees Celsius.

pairs.before: Be careful, the terminal might be live.
pairs.after: WARNING: Do not touch the terminal. The terminal has a dangerous voltage.
pairs.why: Command first, then the risk. Fact instead of hedge.

pairs.before: Failure to tighten the bolts may lead to damage of the housing.
pairs.after: CAUTION: Tighten the bolts. Loose bolts can cause damage to the housing.
pairs.why: Caution is for damage; command first.
